Name: Ridged Peaks
Description: Sharpens high terrain into narrower, ridge-like peaks while preserving each peak's maximum height.

Sections.Name: Peaks
Sections.Label: Peak shaping
Sections.Description: Controls which heights are sharpened and how narrow the peaks become.

Params.Name: Threshold
Params.Label: Peak threshold
Params.Description: Normalized height above which terrain is sharpened. Lower terrain is unchanged.

Params.Name: Sharpness
Params.Label: Ridge sharpness
Params.Description: Higher values compress more of each peak's shoulders while preserving its top. A value of 1 leaves the terrain unchanged.

Params.Name: Feather
Params.Label: Feather
Params.Description: Blends peak shaping in gradually above the threshold. Zero uses a crisp threshold.

Sections.Name: Detail
Sections.Label: Ridged detail
Sections.Description: Adds resolution-aware detail to sharpened peaks. Each octave doubles frequency and halves amplitude.

Params.Name: Frequency
Params.Label: Detail scale
Params.Description: Sets the size of the first ridge octave. Higher values create finer detail.

Params.Name: Octaves
Params.Label: Octaves
Params.Description: Number of detail layers. Each octave adds finer detail when the terrain resolution can represent it.

Params.Name: DetailStrength
Params.Label: Detail strength
Params.Description: Controls how strongly octave detail changes the peak shoulders.
